Each gave 90 pages and 'links: 3998 internal links ... 0 problems'. Preview ran on port 7420. Original reproducer site/tests/e2e/redteam-RT-05-p6-embed-link-contrast.spec.ts, brought in with git show worktree-agent-a9713d93ac4c60748:<path> and removed afterwards. On the base build: 2 failed, 1 passed. The failures were 'Open the Atlas page of E8' in rgb(0, 0, 238) on rgb(18, 18, 18), ratio 1.99, and '[GSS12] Theorem 1.2, with the signs reve' with ratio 1.99. The /tools control passed. On the branch build: 3 passed. The fixer's tests in embed.spec.ts are :521, :532, :547 (control) and :583, each with '// regression: P6-RT-05-01'. The fixer's site/tests/e2e/frozen-table-scroll.spec.ts has 5 tests under two '// regression: P6-RT-05-02' markers: frozen M9 b6, M9 b7, M1 b5, M3 b8, and one test without JavaScript. Scratch revert 2: ToolFrame.svelte taken from 9b24eea with only data-scroll="table-view" added to its fieldset.bare, rebuilt, then restored with git checkout. The focused box shows solid 3px rgb(0, 114, 178) in light and rgb(86, 180, 233) in dark, and a page screenshot at 320 shows the ring in full. I ran axe with the tags of a11y.spec.ts at 320, with every table view open, on 12 routes: 7 tools, /embed/garden/, /embed/satake/, M0, M1, and M9 with b6 and b7 frozen. No serious or critical violation.

Original reproducer redteam-RT-05-p6-predict-answer-minus.spec.ts. On the base build it failed with 'Expected "The answer is (−1, −1, 0)." Received "The answer is (-1, -1, 0)."', and the live region said 'Shown. The answer is (-1, -1, 0). Mutating city 2 turns ...'. On the branch build it passed. The fixer's site/tests/e2e/predict-answer-minus.spec.ts has 4 tests (M9 b6, M9 b7, M0 b4 'Show me', M0 b4 wrong answer) with '// regression: P6-RT-05-04'. On the branch: 4 passed. Scratch revert: the base build, where Predict.svelte is back on predictionAnswerText and interop.ts has no predictionAnswerShown or predictionAnswerSpoken. Result: 4 failed. The pairs were '(−1, −1, 0)' against '(-1, -1, 0)', 'The answer is (−1, −1).' against 'The answer is (-1, -1).', 'The answer is −1.' against 'The answer is -1.', and 'Not quite: the answer is −1.' against 'Not quite: the answer is -1.'. By hand on the branch I resolved all 22 predictions of M0 to M9 with 'Show me' from the keyboard. Each result line uses U+2212, each live region says the answer with 'minus' (M9 b6: 'Shown. The answer is (minus 1, minus 1, 0).'), the focus stays on the button, and there was no page error. Left for the owner, not part of the finding: the <details> answer (.answer-text) still shows '(-1, -1, 0)' with the ASCII hyphen. This is the fixer's open question.

The original reproducer redteam-RT-06-p6-nojs-blank-figure.spec.ts, from worktree-agent-ab01232faaf6b3607, applies its own copy of the f07eec6 predicate. It therefore fails the same way on base and on branch: ['b3 as board', 'b7 as board', 'b12 as board'], and ['atlas (page) as drawing'] twice. A scratch copy with that block replaced by the branch's ToolReport, toolReport and figureProblems gave 3 passed on the branch build. The fixer's tests are nojs.spec.ts:587, :623 (atlas/B3/ and tools/atlas/) and :651, M9.spec.ts:380 and T14.spec.ts:891, each with '// regression: P6-RT-06-01'. On the branch: 6 passed. Scratch revert: a copy of the branch's nojs.spec.ts with its predicate block taken from 9b24eea. The 4 nojs tests failed: ['b3 as board', 'b7 as board', 'b12 as board'], ['atlas (page) as drawing'] twice, and 'b3: the shadow picture without marks' received ''. For M9.spec.ts:380 and T14.spec.ts:891 I mutated the built pages: the circles of b3's shadow picture, of the b7 and b12 restricted boards and of the atlas/B3 drawing were renamed. Both new tests failed: M9 with 'Expected: 1 Received: 0' circles per point, T14 with 'atlas/B3/ B3: a disc per node' Expected 3, Received 0. The existing 'M9 renders without JavaScript' and 'B3 without JavaScript' still passed on those pages. Check that nothing is loosened: I ran both predicates on every tool root of the branch build without JavaScript, 185 roots on 77 routes. Both gave the same figure kind for every root and neither reported a problem. By construction the new boards and drawings are subsets of the old ones, every board group or named drawing that drops out is reported as a blank part, and HTML role-img drawings keep childElementCount > 0. So any root the old predicate rejects, the new one rejects too. The full nojs.spec.ts sweep gave 198 passed.

sideEffects: Minor, SPEC 7.5 A-11: T13's 'Show as table' view no longer reflows its narrower tables at 320 px. ToolFrame's new inner <fieldset class="table-fields"> keeps the browser's min-inline-size: min-content. Its computed min-width is 'min-content', where the old scroll box fieldset.bare had min-width: 0. So the fieldset is as wide as the widest table (370 px, 'Restricted board A1'), and the narrower tables are laid out at that width. 'Multiplicities by length class' grows from 288 to 304 px: the header 'Restricted roots' no longer wraps, the 'Multiplicity' column is cut at the box edge and now needs horizontal scrolling, and the view is 24 px shorter. I measured all 148 table views on 40 routes at 320, base against branch. Only T13 changed: M9 b1 to b12 (on b10 the second table went from 288x373 to 316x321), /tools/satake/ and /embed/satake/. With min-width: 0 injected on the inner fieldset on the branch, the table is back to 288 and the box still scrolls (scrollWidth 370). table-reflow.spec.ts does not catch this because it checks page-level scroll only.

No other change found. Pages using Base.astro (/, /glossary/, M1, M9, /tools/garden/, /tools/satake/), light and dark at 360: the computed colour, outline and offset of every a, button, summary and tab stop are identical between base and branch. The Tab walks with focus rings are identical (18, 139, 257, 345, 36 and 33 stops). Full-page screenshots are pixel-identical except for the footer's commit hash, and a 2 px anti-aliased column at x=358 on /tools/garden/ that also differs between two runs of the same build. /embed/garden/ and /embed/satake/: pixel-identical, with identical Tab walks. On /embed/atlas/?g=E8 only the link's colour and focus ring changed, which is the fix. On the 15 /tools/<id>/ routes with a table view, base and branch have the same enabled table buttons, and Enter on the first button has the same effect on both. The one difference is the intended new tab stop (the box) between the summary and the buttons, which the decisions fragment records.

Against the base build (--dist), 40 routes grew by 34 to 148 bytes gzip and none shrank. The largest are /tools/satake/, /embed/satake/ and /modules/m9-real-forms/ at 87.2 kB of 90.
